connector.name: Meteor
connector.registryDescription: Ejecuta Mets, gestiona contactos y tareas, y lee los datos de tu workspace.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.met.meteor.com.co over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace co.com.meteor, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <tu API key met_…>, con el scope mcp:use.
